items.text: The FAIRness Project (briefing to the National Geospatial Advisory Committee, April 2024). NOT ADMITTED (excluded:out_of_scope). no in-corpus reference points at it and it is not a member of any scoped layer. Recorded as assessed and declined, which is a different state from nobody having looked. Assessed mechanically by kg/assess.py against docs/runbook_document_admission.md §1 and corpus/layers.yaml. || PRIOR NOTE, PRESERVED: Found while resolving footnote 11, not named by the addendum, and cataloged so the decision is on the record (CLAUDE.md: every document the project has considered has one manifest entry). Nine slides from the same project, six months before B3.3, briefing the FGDC's advisory committee. Its content overlaps B3.3's and adds the geospatial side. Cataloged by kg/catalog.py; the admission decision is kg/assess.py's.

Building Trust and FAIRness into the Process for Finding and Using Government Data Project (FAIRness Project): Implementing DCAT-US 3.0 Sequencing Plan. NOT ADMITTED (excluded:restricted). no public copy: Provided to OMB and not published. The FAIRness Project co-chairs' 2024 FCSM conference slides (session B3.3, slide 6) give its status as "Provided to Office of Management and Budget". Searched 2026-10-05 and absent from resources.data.gov, councils.gov, statspolicy.gov, the DOI-DO/dcat-us and GSA/dcat-us repositories and the DOI-DO/dcat-us wiki. A public request for it, DOI-DO/dcat-us issue #214 (2024-07-15), is open and unanswered. The corpus is 100% public (CLAUDE.md); 1 in-corpus segment(s) cite it, so basis (a) would hold if it were published. REVISIT IF: it is published at a source a program can fetch with no login. Assessed mechanically by kg/assess.py against docs/runbook_document_admission.md §1 and corpus/layers.yaml. || PRIOR NOTE, PRESERVED: The Implementation Guide's footnote 11, cited for the statement that OMB mandated DCAT-US v3.0 "to ensure datasets are more visible, accessible, and useful across the broader data ecosystem". The FAIRness Project's second deliverable: "a strategic two-year sequencing (i.e., transition) plan to improve and integrate government-wide metadata cataloging to facilitate data users being able to easily find, access, assess for fitness-for-use, and use federal data" (wiki Project Overview). Per the B3.3 slides it contains key findings and recommendations and what OMB, the councils, agencies and service providers need to consider. That is the FCSM side's record of what it asked for, and it is not public. Cataloged by kg/catalog.py; the admission decision is kg/assess.py's.
